items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: a year later, our daughter was born -- a daughter named Naomi

ctx.x: That's beautiful. So go on -- you got married and then?
Well, we got married at 17 and she was 19 at the time, and a year later, our daughter was born -- a daughter named Naomi, who was named after my
sister that died; her name was Naomi; this was our first born. And we stayed together -- Helen and I stayed together for 25 years.
